paper_id: Online Deployment Algorithms for Microservice Systems with Complex Dependencies
title: Online Deployment Algorithms for Microservice Systems with Complex Dependencies
motivation: Microservice systems需要快速迭代和持续交付,但现有方法未充分考虑服务间复杂依赖和多实例支持,导致QoS不稳定
problem_framing: 将服务放置问题建模为分式多项式问题(FPP),要求算法执行时间不超过容器启动时间5-10秒
key_insight: 响应时间沿函数链可分解为相邻函数对响应时间之和,使FPP可转化为二次比值和问题(QSRFP)大幅降低复杂度
method_signature: 基于Theorem 1将FPP转化为QSRFP,提出B/D/BD-QSRFP三种贪心部署算法
evaluation_criteria: 平均响应时间(质量)和算法执行时间(速度),对比GMCAPP/LDSPP/Random/GA
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: BD-QSRFP执行时间在50/100服务器时达11s/52s,过高不适于在线;100服务器已超出算法承受范围
evidence_for_taste: algorithm execution time should not exceed 5~10s
which is too costly for an online algorithm
GA performed worse than other experiments
we suggest dividing it into several small groups whose server size does not exceed 100
deploying more instances can improve the average response time at the cost of a much higher execution time
thinking_moves: 将问题分解为子问题:bestServer找最优服务器,DeploySpread处理实例部署和依赖传播
证明Theorem 1将不可行的FPP转化为可处理的QSRFP,实现复杂度跨越
从工程约束(容器启动时间)反推算法时间预算,指导算法设计方向
承认穷举最优解(BD-QSRFP)不适于在线,建议B/D-QSRFP作为实用替代
